description.fallback: The Joestar group continues their journey to Cairo in order to stop DIO and rescue Holy from her curse. They take a quick stop in Luxor, where Joseph decides to use the restroom. However, he quickly decides not to when he realizes how primitive it is.

They take a quick stop in Luxor, where Joseph decides to use the restroom.

outro.fallback: The man loses his grip and the hammer goes flying towards Joseph, but Avdol catches it.
Not realizing what happened, the group assumes the man threw his hammer in frustration after possibly hammering his finger, so they think nothing of it and continue toward a hotel.
